subject: Английский язык
authors: Вербицкая М. В., Эббс Б., Уорелл Э., Уорд Э.

problems.condition: Unit 1 New friends, упр. 1, с. 4. Рассмотри рисунки и скажи, кого из ребят ты помнишь. Прослушай историю.
steps: На рисунках знакомые герои из 3 класса: Vera, Dasha, Nikita, Maxim, Sam, Kate.
I remember Vera, Dasha and Nikita.
problems.answer: I remember Vera, Dasha, Nikita and Maxim.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 2, с. 5. Прочитай текст (диалог в лагере «Forward»).
steps: — Where are you from? — We are from Russia. We are Russian. — Vera, what's your favourite sport? — I like tennis. — I don't like tennis. I like swimming. — Let's go swimming!
problems.answer: Диалог ребят о том, откуда они и какой спорт любят, прочитан.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 3, с. 5. Задайте друг другу вопросы о ребятах из текста.
steps: A: Who is from Russia? — B: Vera, Dasha, Nikita and Maxim are from Russia.
A: Who likes tennis? — B: Vera likes tennis. A: Who likes swimming? — B: Dasha likes swimming.
problems.answer: Who is from Russia? — Vera, Dasha, Nikita and Maxim. Who likes tennis? — Vera. Who likes swimming? — Dasha.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 4, с. 5. Прочитай удостоверения личности Сэма и Кейт и расскажи о них. Обрати внимание на новые слова.
steps: Sam Roberts is 11. His birthday is on 3 July. He is from Newtown, England. He is British. He has a dog. He likes reading detective stories. His phone number is 567 894. Now he is in the International Holiday Camp "Forward" in Sochi.
Kate Lewis is 11. Her birthday is on 18 August. She is from Newtown, England. She is British. She has a cat. She likes music.
problems.answer: Рассказ по удостоверениям: имя, возраст, день рождения, откуда, национальность, питомец, хобби, телефон.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 5, с. 6. Покажи на рисунке, из какой страны эти ребята, и найди страны на глобусе.
steps: Robert is from the USA — he is American. Eva is from Poland — she is Polish. Mitsuko is from Japan — she is Japanese. Rose is from Argentina — she is Argentinian. Ta-Ming is from China — he is Chinese. Pavel is from Russia — he is Russian.
problems.answer: Robert — the USA (American), Eva — Poland (Polish), Mitsuko — Japan (Japanese), Rose — Argentina (Argentinian), Ta-Ming — China (Chinese), Pavel — Russia (Russian)

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 6, с. 6. По образцу обсудите ребят с картинки.
steps: A: Where does Robert come from? — B: He is from the USA. What nationality is Eva? — A: She's Polish. What nationality is Mitsuko? — B: She's Japanese. Where does Ta-Ming come from? — A: He comes from China.
problems.answer: Where does … come from? — He / she comes from … What nationality is …? — He / she is …

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 7, с. 6. Расскажи, откуда родом твой друг и какой он национальности.
steps: Mark is from the UK. He is British. / My friend Anna is from Russia. She is Russian.
problems.answer: My friend … is from … He / she is …

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 8, с. 7. Найди слова по транскрипции, переведи и запиши в алфавитном порядке.
steps: Argentina — Аргентина, Australia — Австралия, Britain — Британия, China — Китай, Italy — Италия, Japan — Япония, Poland — Польша, Russia — Россия, Spain — Испания, the USA — США.
problems.answer: Argentina, Australia, Britain, China, Italy, Japan, Poland, Russia, Spain, the USA

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 9, с. 7. Вспомни, кто из ребят из какой страны, и задай вопросы другу.
steps: A: Who is Russian? — B: Pavel is Russian. A: Where does he come from? — B: He comes from Russia.
A: Who is Argentinian? — B: Rose. She comes from Argentina. A: Who is Chinese? — B: Ta-Ming. He comes from China.
problems.answer: Who is …? — … is … Where does he / she come from? — He / she comes from …

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 10, с. 7. Сделай удостоверения личности для ребят (Даша, Вера, Никита, Максим).
steps: Identity card: Name — Dasha. Age — 11. Birthday — 5 November. Nationality — Russian. From — Moscow. Pet — a puppy. Hobby — singing and dancing.
Name — Vera. Age — 11. Birthday — 25 May. Nationality — Russian. From — Moscow. Pet — a cat. Hobby — tennis.
problems.answer: Удостоверения по полям: Name, Age, Birthday, Nationality, From, Pet, Hobby — для каждого героя.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 11, с. 7. Сыграй в игру «Угадай, кто это» с общими вопросами.
steps: A: Is it a girl? — B: Yes. A: Is she from Russia? — B: Yes. A: Is she from Moscow? — B: Yes. A: Is it Dasha? — B: No. A: Is it Lera? — B: Yes!
problems.answer: Задаём общие вопросы Is it…? Is she from…? до угадывания героя.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 12, с. 8. Прослушай и прочитай диалог Кейт и Леры.
steps: Lera: Hi! I'm Vera's friend. I'm Russian, from Moscow. Kate: What's your name? Lera: My name is Valeria Petrova, but my friends call me Lera. Kate: How old are you? Lera: I'm 11. And you? Kate: I'm 11 too. I'm from Newtown.
problems.answer: Диалог знакомства: имя, как зовут друзья, возраст, откуда.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 13, с. 8. В парах обсудите Кейт и Леру.
steps: A: Who is Valeria Petrova? — B: It's Vera's friend. A: What do her friends call her? — B: Lera. A: How old is she? — B: She is 11. A: How old is Kate? — B: She is 11. A: Where is Kate from? — B: From Newtown.
problems.answer: Valeria Petrova is Vera's friend, her friends call her Lera, she is 11; Kate is 11 and from Newtown.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 14, с. 8. Найди шесть слов (школьные предметы), закончи вопрос найденным словом и ответь на него.
steps: lesson — урок, art — рисование, history — история, maths — математика, science — естествознание, music — музыка.
What's your favourite lesson? — My favourite lesson is English.
problems.answer: lesson, art, history, maths, science, music; What's your favourite lesson? — English.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 15, с. 9. Реши примеры по-английски.
steps: 95 − 65 = 30 (thirty). 54 + 46 = 100 (a hundred). 24 + 63 = 87 (eighty-seven). 14 + 72 − 19 = 67 (sixty-seven).

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 16, с. 9. Ответь на вопросы о погоде в Сочи и Москве в ноябре и о кенгуру.
steps: 1. The weather in Sochi in November is nice: it is usually warm and sunny. In Moscow it is cold, rainy, sometimes snowy and windy.
2. Kangaroos are from Australia.
problems.answer: 1. Sochi — warm and sunny; Moscow — cold and rainy. 2. Kangaroos come from Australia.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 17, с. 9. Прослушай песню о животных в зоопарке и спой её.
steps: Песня о животных, которые скучают по дому: панда мечтает о Китае, кенгуру — об Австралии; им нравилось бегать на воле и лазить по деревьям.
Новые слова: free — свободный, climb — лазить, dream — мечтать.
problems.answer: Песня про животных, мечтающих о родных странах (Китай, Австралия); поём по учебнику.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 18, с. 9. Напиши, нравятся ли тебе уроки русского языка. Переведи фразы и обрати внимание на формы местоимений.
steps: I like Russian lessons. / I don't like Russian lessons.
Английское you означает и «ты», и «вы» — в русском два разных слова, выбор зависит от вежливости обращения.
problems.answer: I like Russian lessons. Местоимение you = «ты» и «вы».

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 19, с. 9. Прочитай предложения и соедини их с картинками.
steps: 1 — рисунок 2; 2 — рисунок 3; 3 — рисунок 1; 4 — рисунок 4.

problems.condition: Unit 1, упр. 20, с. 9. Поговори с другом: ответь на вопросы о себе и своём дне.
steps: My name is Misha. I come to school at a quarter to nine. I have breakfast at eight o'clock. I have lunch at two o'clock. My favourite food is pizza. Yes, I'm hungry — I want an apple. Yes, I'm thirsty — I want some orange juice.
problems.answer: Ответы о себе: имя, во сколько приходишь в школу, завтрак, обед, любимая еда, hungry / thirsty.

problems.condition: Unit 2 A message on the computer, упр. 1, с. 10. Рассмотри рисунки, прослушай запись и скажи, какой урок идёт в классе.
steps: Дети сидят за компьютерами — это урок информатики.
problems.answer: They have a computer science class.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 2, с. 11. Прочитай текст в группах (сообщение на компьютере).
steps: На экране появляется сообщение: «My name is Professor Wallace. I'm in the rain forest. I need help!» Ребята удивлены и хотят помочь.
problems.answer: Текст о загадочном сообщении профессора Уоллес из тропического леса прочитан по ролям.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 3, с. 11. 1) Прочитай и скажи, кто учёный из Малайзии, исследователь из США, учитель из Англии. 2) Прослушай и скажи, кто говорит. 3) Обсуди удостоверения личности.
steps: 1) Professor Wallace is a scientist from Malaysia. Joseph Alexander is an explorer from the USA. Mr Freeman is a teacher from England.
2) 1 — Professor Wallace, 2 — Mr Freeman, 3 — Joseph Alexander.
3) What's her name? — Professor Wallace. Where's she from? — Malaysia. How old is she? — 35. What colour is her hair? — Black. What does she do? — She is a scientist.
problems.answer: 1) Wallace — scientist, Malaysia; Alexander — explorer, USA; Freeman — teacher, England. 2) Wallace, Freeman, Alexander. 3) Вопросы о карточке: name, from, age, hair, eyes, job.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 4, с. 12. Прочитай текст и скажи, кто изображён на плакате и кто из банды преследует профессора.
steps: On the police poster: Polly Zap, Zack and Tex — the Red Hand Gang. Polly Zap is following the Professor.
problems.answer: На плакате Polly Zap, Zack и Tex; профессора преследует Polly Zap.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 5, с. 12. Составь вопросы о банде «Красная рука» и задай их другу.
steps: A: He is short and has got black hair. Who is it? — B: Zack. A: He is tall and has got glasses. Who is it? — B: Tex. A: She has got red hair. Who is it? — B: Polly Zap.
problems.answer: Описываем внешность (tall / short, hair, glasses) — друг угадывает: Zack, Tex, Polly Zap.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 6, с. 13. Выпиши прилагательные в четыре столбика: рост, цвет волос, цвет глаз, телосложение.
steps: Рост: tall, short. Цвет волос: dark, fair, red. Цвет глаз: brown, black, green, blue. Телосложение: thin, fat.
problems.answer: Height: tall, short. Hair: dark, fair, red. Eyes: brown, black, green, blue. Build: thin, fat.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 7, с. 13. Скажи, какие формы глаголов нужны для описания своей внешности, внешности собеседника и знакомого.
steps: О себе: I am tall. I've got dark hair. О собеседнике: You are tall. You've got dark hair. О другом: He / she is tall. He / she has got dark hair.
problems.answer: I am / I've got; you are / you've got; he (she) is / he (she) has got

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 8, с. 13. Прочитай удостоверение Леры и сделай такие же для себя и друга.
steps: Identity card: Name — Julia Bing. Birthday — 27 September. Age — 11. Nationality — Russian. From — Moscow. Hair — dark. Eyes — blue. Favourite book — Sleeping Beauty, subject — English, colour — black.
Аналогично — для друга.
problems.answer: Карточки с полями: name, birthday, age, nationality, from, colour of hair, colour of eyes, favourite book / subject / colour.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 9, с. 13. Перепиши текст, заполнив пропуски.
steps: years old, got, on, from, scientist.
problems.answer: years old, got, on, from, scientist

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 10, с. 14. Прослушай и прочитай названия профессий, ответь на вопросы.
steps: explorer — исследователь, scientist — учёный, detective — детектив, chemist — химик, engineer — инженер, journalist — журналист, traveller — путешественник, astronaut — космонавт.
problems.answer: explorer, scientist, detective, chemist, engineer, journalist, traveller, astronaut

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 11, с. 14. Составь диалог о том, кто эти люди и какие у них профессии.
steps: A: Who is this man? — B: He is Lera's father. A: What does he do? — B: He is a pilot.
Nikita's uncle is a detective. Vera's father is an engineer. Dasha's mother is a journalist.
problems.answer: Who is this? — He is …'s father / uncle. What does he do? — He is a pilot / detective / engineer / journalist.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 12, с. 15. Прослушай и прочитай текст, ответь на вопросы об интонации.
steps: Общие вопросы (Does she need help? Is he in London? Can we go to London?) произносятся с повышением голоса в конце.
Специальные вопросы (What's the matter? Where is he?) — с понижением.
problems.answer: Общие вопросы — восходящая интонация, специальные — нисходящая.

problems.condition: Unit 2, упр. 13, с. 15. Прочитай диалог и дополни его (описание Полли Зап).
steps: She's tall. No, she has got short dark hair. No, she hasn't. She is wearing blue jeans and a red jacket. She also has glasses. She has got three bags.
problems.answer: tall; short dark hair; no; blue jeans and a red jacket, glasses; three bags

problems.condition: Unit 3 A computer magazine, упр. 1, с. 16. Послушай и посмотри на страницы журнала о компьютерах.
steps: Дети учатся пользоваться компьютером в школе (keyboard, screen). Женщина работает с компьютером в аэропорту. Инженеры проектируют на компьютерах машины и космические корабли. Полиция ловит преступников с помощью компьютеров.
problems.answer: Компьютеры используют в школе, в аэропорту, инженеры, полиция.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 2, с. 16. Покажи на иллюстрациях, что означают выделенные слова, и расскажи по-русски, для чего нужны компьютеры.
steps: keyboard — клавиатура; screen — экран; space shuttle — космический шаттл; use — использовать; design — проектировать; work — работать; police — полиция; criminal — преступник.
Компьютеры нужны, чтобы учиться, работать, проектировать машины и корабли, ловить преступников.
problems.answer: keyboard, screen, space shuttle, use, design, work, police, criminal — переведены; компьютеры нужны для учёбы, работы, проектирования, полиции.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 3, с. 17. Выпиши со страниц журнала слова и подумай об их значении.
steps: police — полиция, criminal — преступник, keyboard — клавиатура, engineer — инженер, design — проектировать.
problems.answer: police, criminal, keyboard, engineer, design

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 4, с. 17. Послушай разговоры и покажи нужный рисунок.
steps: 1 — picture 2; 2 — picture 4; 3 — picture 3.
problems.answer: picture 2, picture 4, picture 3

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 5, с. 17. Спроси друзей, у скольких человек в классе есть компьютеры.
steps: Have you got a computer? — считаем ответы: Twenty people in my class have a computer.
problems.answer: … people in my class have got a computer.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 6, с. 17. Составь список мест, где люди работают на компьютерах.
steps: There are computers at the airport, in hospitals, in schools, in the underground, at the police station, in banks, in offices.
problems.answer: airport, hospitals, schools, underground, police station, banks, offices

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 7, с. 18. Прочитай и укажи правильную картинку.
problems.answer: c, e, b, d, f, a

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 8, с. 18. Напиши, кем ты хочешь стать, спроси друга и составь диалог.
steps: A: I want to be an astronaut. I want to go to the Moon. And what about you? — B: I want to be a vet. I want to help sick animals.
problems.answer: I want to be a … I want to … And you? — I want to be a …

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 9, с. 18. 1) Послушай, как люди рассказывают о работе, и угадай профессии. 2) Сыграй в игру «Угадай профессию».
steps: 1) a detective, a pilot, a scientist, a chef, a vet, an engineer.
2) — Do you work in a restaurant? — Yes. — Do you cook food? — Yes. — Are you a chef? — Yes! — Do you travel a lot? — Yes. — Do you fly planes? — Yes. — Are you a pilot? — Yes!
problems.answer: 1) detective, pilot, scientist, chef, vet, engineer. 2) Вопросы Do you…? Are you a…?

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 10, с. 19. Послушай и прочитай сочетания местоимений с глаголами в Present Simple, правильно произнося окончания.
steps: he learns, she listens, it needs, he reads, she lives, he comes, she plays, he delivers, she writes, he washes /ɪz/, she catches /ɪz/, he teaches /ɪz/.
-s читается /s/ после глухих, /z/ после звонких и гласных, /ɪz/ после шипящих.
problems.answer: learns, listens, needs, reads, lives, comes, plays, delivers, writes, washes, catches, teaches

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 11, с. 19. 1) Найди продолжение для каждого предложения о профессиях. 2) В парах задайте вопросы о профессиях.
steps: 2) What do engineers do? — They design things. What do vets do? — They look after sick animals. What do pilots do? — They fly planes. What do doctors do? — They look after sick people. What do detectives do? — They catch criminals. What do scientists do? — They work in laboratories.
problems.answer: 1) b, a, d, c, f, e. 2) What do … do? — They design / look after / fly / catch / work…

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 12, с. 19. Напиши о привычках ребят по образцу.
steps: Maxim does exercises in the morning every day. Sometimes he plays computer games.
Sam has lunch at 2 o'clock every day. Sometimes he walks in the park.
problems.answer: … every day. Sometimes he …

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 13, с. 20. Поговори о профессиях: что делают и что им нужно. Добавь свои примеры.
steps: What does a detective do? — A detective catches criminals. What does he need? — He needs a dog.
What does a postman do? — He delivers letters. He needs a bag. What does a scientist do? — He learns more about plants and animals. He needs a laboratory.
problems.answer: What does a … do? — A … catches / delivers / learns… What does he need? — He needs a dog / a bag / a laboratory.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 14, с. 20. Напиши ответы по образцу, используя Present Simple.
steps: He designs cars. She looks after sick people. He learns more about rare plants and animals. She catches criminals. They cook food for people.
problems.answer: He designs cars. She looks after sick people. He learns about rare plants and animals. She catches criminals. They cook food.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 15, с. 20. Прочитай текст, заполняя пропуски.
steps: explorer, twenty-seven, the USA, red, green, glasses.
problems.answer: explorer, twenty-seven, the USA, red, green, glasses

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 16, с. 21. Прочитай текст и скажи, кем хочет стать Максим.
steps: Максим любит математику и информатику, играет в компьютерные игры и хочет стать программистом (computer programmer).
problems.answer: Maxim wants to be a computer programmer.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 17, с. 21. Расскажи о себе, используя рассказ Максима как образец.
steps: I like to go to school on Tuesday. We have English and a computer class on Tuesday. These are my favourite subjects. I've got many friends. I write letters to them every week. I like computers, but I like football more. My mother is a vet. I want to be a doctor.
problems.answer: Рассказ о себе: любимый день и предметы, друзья, увлечения, профессии родителей, кем хочешь стать.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 18, с. 21. По картинкам поговори с другом о том, что дети делают в компьютерном клубе.
steps: — Is she at school? — Yes, she is. — Is it a computer club? — Yes, it is. — Does she use a computer? — Yes, she does. — What does she want to be? — She wants to be a programmer.
problems.answer: Вопросы Is she…? Does she…? What does she want to be? — по картинкам.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 19, с. 22. Прочитай письмо Максима и скажи, что он хочет узнать у Сэма.
steps: Максим спрашивает: What's the weather like in the rain forests? Is it really hot and wet there?
problems.answer: Maxim wants to know what the weather is like in the rain forests — is it really hot and wet.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 20, с. 22. Скажи, в каких предложениях выделенные слова — существительные, а в каких — прилагательные.
steps: 1 — существительное, 2 — прилагательное, 3 — прилагательное, 4 — прилагательное, 5 — существительное.
problems.answer: noun, adjective, adjective, adjective, noun

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 21, с. 22. Прослушай и повтори, что говорит компьютер, ответь на его вопросы.
steps: Hello! My name's Compo. I'm a friendly computer. What's your name? — My name is Sasha. What's your friend's name? — His name is Maxim. Do you want to play a game? — Yes, I do. — Good! Let's play!
problems.answer: My name is … My friend's name is … Yes, I want to play a game.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 22, с. 23. Компьютерная игра «Скажи, что сделать Джеку»: составь предложения по картинкам с глаголами из рамки.
steps: Find the birthday cake in the shop. Climb up the ladder. Jump over the dog. Cross the road. Go through the forest. Swim across the river. Run away from the hungry cats. Arrive at the party.
problems.answer: Find the cake, climb up the ladder, jump over the dog, cross the road, go through the forest, swim across the river, run away from the cats, arrive at the party.

problems.condition: Unit 3, упр. 23, с. 23. Придумай свою компьютерную игру по образцу упр. 22.
steps: Find the present in the shop. Go down the stairs. Jump over the bench. Cross the road. Go through the park. Swim across the lake. Run away from the angry dogs. Arrive at the party.
problems.answer: Своя цепочка команд: find, go down, jump over, cross, go through, swim across, run away from, arrive at.

problems.condition: Unit 4 In the rain forest, упр. 1, с. 24. Прослушай историю и скажи, кто следит за профессором Уоллес.
steps: За профессором следит Polly Zap из банды «Красная рука».
problems.answer: Polly Zap.

steps: Professor Wallace is looking for a rare orchid in the rain forest. She has some problems: yesterday her computer was OK, but today it doesn't work. Polly Zap is following her.
problems.answer: Профессор ищет редкую орхидею, её компьютер сломался, а за ней следит Полли Зап.

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 3, с. 25. Найди всех животных на картинках, прослушай запись и покажи их.
steps: A frog, three monkeys, seven birds, a snake, a rabbit.
problems.answer: a frog, 3 monkeys, 7 birds, a snake, a rabbit

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 4, с. 25. Прослушай запись и скажи, верные или неверные факты говорят ребята.
steps: False, True, False, True, True, False, True, False, True.
problems.answer: F, T, F, T, T, F, T, F, T

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 5, с. 26. Прочитай предложения и соотнеси их с картинками 1–6.
steps: Steven was at home. Sarah was at the station. Simon was in the office. Alison was at the pizzeria. Carlo was in the video shop. Jane was at the newsagent's.
problems.answer: Steven — home, Sarah — station, Simon — office, Alison — pizzeria, Carlo — video shop, Jane — newsagent's

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 6, с. 26. 1) Прослушай интервью детектива и скажи, кто говорит неправду. 2) Разыграй интервью в парах.
steps: 1) Carlo isn't telling the truth.
2) Detective: Steven? Can I ask you some questions? Where were you yesterday at 8 o'clock? — Steven: I was at home in the kitchen.
problems.answer: 1) Carlo. 2) Where were you yesterday at …? — I was at …

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 7, с. 26. Спроси друга, где он был вчера.
steps: A: Were you at home yesterday at 3 o'clock? — B: No. A: Where were you? — B: I was at school.
problems.answer: Were you at … yesterday? — No, I was at …

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 8, с. 27. 1) Прослушай и повтори описание рисунка. 2) Опиши по-английски сценку из жизни леса.
steps: 1) There are seven trees. There are six monkeys in the trees. The monkeys are brown. There are three parrots. There is a tree house. The house is small. There is a snake near the house.
2) There are six trees in the forest. The sky is blue. The grass is green. There is an owl. The owl wears glasses.
problems.answer: Описание с There is / There are: деревья, обезьяны, попугаи, домик, змея.

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 9, с. 27. Прослушай песню про глупые вопросы и скажи, задаёшь ли ты такие.
steps: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
problems.answer: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 10, с. 27. Придумай глупые вопросы.
steps: Why can't people fly? When will my cat speak? How can I catch a star? What is the time at midnight? Why can't a fish giggle?
problems.answer: Why can't people fly? When will my cat speak? How can I catch a star?

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 11, с. 28. Найди в подписях к картинкам на с. 24–25 предложения со словом yesterday и скажи, какие формы to be в них употребляются.
steps: Yesterday my computer was OK. Yesterday we were in the forest. — формы was и were.
problems.answer: was, were

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 12, с. 28. Посмотри на картинки и скажи, что было в порядке вчера, но испорчено сегодня, и чем не могут заняться ребята.
steps: My camera was OK yesterday, but it is no good today. I can't take photos. My guitar was OK yesterday, but it is no good today. I can't play songs. My book was OK yesterday, but it is no good today. I can't read. My shoes were OK yesterday, but they are no good today. I can't wear them.
problems.answer: … was / were OK yesterday, but … is / are no good today. I can't …

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 13, с. 28. В парах обсудите, что случилось у ребят из упр. 12.
steps: A: Was Lera's camera OK yesterday? — B: Yes, it was. A: Can she take photos today? — B: No, she can't. A: Was Nikita's guitar OK yesterday? — B: Yes, it was. A: Can he play songs today? — B: No, he can't.
problems.answer: Was …'s … OK yesterday? — Yes, it was. Can he / she … today? — No, he / she can't.

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 14, с. 29. Обсудите, где ваши одноклассники были вчера.
steps: A: What day is it today? — B: Today's Monday. A: Were you at school yesterday? — B: No, I wasn't. A: Where were you? — B: I was in the library.
problems.answer: Were you at school yesterday? — No, I wasn't. Where were you? — I was in …

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 15, с. 29. С какими местоимениями множественного числа употребляется were, а с каким местоимением единственного числа?
steps: were — с you, we, they (множественное число) и с you в единственном числе («ты»). was — с I, he, she, it.
problems.answer: were: you, we, they; в единственном числе — you

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 16, с. 29. Составь диалог в парах по примеру (где ты был вчера / на выходных).
steps: A: Hi! Where were you yesterday at 6 o'clock in the evening? — B: I was at the museum with my mum. A: Where were you last weekend at midnight? — B: I was in my bedroom at home. A: Thank you very much.
problems.answer: Where were you … at …? — I was at / in …

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 17, с. 30. Расскажи всё об одном из животных на картинке.
steps: This is a parrot. Parrots live in the jungle. They eat insects and fruit. They can fly. They are very bright.
problems.answer: This is a parrot. It lives in the jungle, eats insects and fruit, can fly.

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 18, с. 30. Опиши одно из животных на картинке (внешность, где живёт, что умеет).
steps: There are a lot of parrots in the jungle. They have got sharp beaks and two beautiful wings. They live in the trees. They eat insects. They can fly, but they can't swim.
problems.answer: Parrots have got sharp beaks and beautiful wings, live in the trees, eat insects, can fly and can't swim.

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 19, с. 30. По таблице составь диалог о дне одной из девочек.
steps: A: Today is Wednesday. Was Dasha at the museum at four o'clock yesterday? — B: Yes, she was. A: Where was Dasha at a quarter past six this evening? — B: She was at the toy shop.
problems.answer: Was … at … at …? — Yes, she was. Where was … at …? — She was at …

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 20, с. 31. Найди девять слов в цепочке и подбери для них общее слово.
steps: kangaroo, spider, frog, snake, parrot, tiger, bear, monkey, rabbit — общее слово: animals.
problems.answer: kangaroo, spider, frog, snake, parrot, tiger, bear, monkey, rabbit — animals

problems.condition: Unit 4, упр. 21, с. 31. Поставь верные знаки препинания в конце предложений.
steps: Where were you yesterday? Can a porcupine smile? Where is Polly Zap? Do you like maths? — все предложения вопросительные.
problems.answer: Все четыре предложения — вопросы, ставим знак «?».

problems.condition: Review 1, упр. 1, с. 32. Соотнеси страны и названия их жителей.
steps: Russia — Russian; Japan — Japanese; Britain — British; Australia — Australian; China — Chinese.
problems.answer: Russia — Russian, Japan — Japanese, Britain — British, Australia — Australian, China — Chinese

problems.condition: Review 1, упр. 2, с. 32. 1) Соотнеси тексты с картинками. 2) Расскажи другу, что делают люди на картинках.
steps: 1) b, a, e, d, c.

2) This is his uncle. He is a policeman. He catches criminals. This is her father. He is an engineer. He designs engines for planes. This is his father. He is a scientist. He studies volcanoes. This is her mother. She is a scientist. She studies plants to make medicines.
problems.answer: 1) b, a, e, d, c. 2) policeman — catches criminals; engineer — designs engines; scientist — studies volcanoes / plants.

problems.condition: Review 1, упр. 3, с. 33. Составь вопросы и ответь на них.
steps: How tall was Nina last year? — She was 100 centimetres tall. How tall is Nina now? — She is 110 centimetres tall. What does Lera want to be? — She wants to be a teacher. What is Lera's favourite lesson? — English.
problems.answer: How tall was / is Nina? — 100 / 110 cm. What does Lera want to be? — a teacher. What is her favourite lesson? — English.

problems.condition: Review 1, упр. 4, с. 33. Дополни ряды слов своими вариантами.
steps: Животные: cats, dogs, birds, zebras, tigers, foxes, hares, elephants. Школьные принадлежности: textbooks, rubbers, scissors, pencil cases, paints, rulers. Мебель: sofas, chairs, beds, lamps, carpets, bookcases.
problems.answer: animals — cats, dogs, tigers, foxes…; school things — textbooks, rubbers, rulers…; furniture — sofas, chairs, beds, bookcases…

problems.condition: Review 1, упр. 5, с. 33. Обсуди вопросы с другом (о себе, семье, школе).
steps: I am nine. I was eight last year. My birthday is on 13 September. My mother is thirty-five. I come to school at eight o'clock. Yes, I was at school yesterday. I like English and Maths. My favourite animal is a dog. I can dance well.
problems.answer: Ответы о себе: возраст, день рождения, семья, школа, любимые предметы и животные, умения.

problems.condition: Review 1, упр. 6, с. 33. Прослушай песенку и задай вопросы к картинкам.
steps: Is your head red? Is the circle purple? What colour is your back? What colour is the ground? What colour is your shoe?
problems.answer: Is … red / purple? What colour is …?

chapters.title: 5. What do you know about rain forests?

problems.condition: Unit 5 What do you know about rain forests?, упр. 1, с. 34. Прослушай и прочитай текст о тропическом лесе.
steps: Погода в тропиках жаркая и влажная. Деревья очень высокие, много разных видов. Внизу темно и много опавших листьев. Птицы и животные живут в кронах деревьев.
problems.answer: Текст о тропическом лесе: hot and wet weather, very tall trees, dark floor, animals in the canopy.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 2, с. 35. Прочитай текст и ответь на вопросы.
steps: The weather is very hot and wet. Yes, they are (the trees are tall). Yes, they are. Yes, they do. There are a lot of dead leaves on the floor. New plants grow where old trees fall down.
problems.answer: hot and wet; yes; yes; yes; dead leaves; where old trees fall down

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 3, с. 35. Расскажи, что ты узнал о тропических лесах.
steps: The trees in the rain forest are very tall. The floor is dark — there are a lot of dead leaves. Birds and animals live in the canopy. Smaller plants grow by the river. When a tree falls down, new plants grow. Rain forests are disappearing very fast.
problems.answer: Tall trees, dark floor with dead leaves, animals in the canopy, plants by the river, new plants where trees fall, forests disappearing fast.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 4, с. 36. Прослушай запись о растении-хищнике и ответь на вопросы.
steps: Pitcher plants grow in the rain forest. They eat insects. The insect falls into the liquid inside the pitcher plant and can't escape.
problems.answer: They grow in rain forests; they eat insects; the insect falls into the liquid inside and can't get out.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 5, с. 36. 1) Прослушай и соотнеси растения с их хозяевами. 2) Поговори о растениях ребят.
steps: 1) a — a, b — b, c — d, d — c.
2) A: How tall is Susie's plant? — B: It's very tall! A: How many leaves or flowers has it got? — B: It has got many leaves and flowers.
problems.answer: 1) a, b, d, c. 2) How tall is …'s plant? How many leaves has it got?

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 6, с. 36. Нарисуй плотоядное растение и расскажи о нём.
steps: This is my pitcher plant. Her name is Angela. She is 30 centimetres tall. Her favourite food is flies and small spiders.
problems.answer: This is my pitcher plant … Its favourite food is flies and spiders.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 7, с. 37. Прочитай текст и ответь на вопросы.
steps: There is no rain forest in Siberia. It's very hot and wet in the rain forest. The trees are very tall. Orchids grow on the tree trunks. A pitcher plant eats insects.
problems.answer: no rain forest in Siberia; hot and wet; very tall; on the tree trunks; insects

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 8, с. 37. Ответь на вопрос песенки о подсолнухе.
steps: Днём подсолнух поворачивается за солнцем; ночью — At night sunflowers look to the east.
problems.answer: At night sunflowers look to the east.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 9, с. 37. Объясни, как образовано слово «подсолнух» (sunflower).
steps: sunflower = sun (солнце) + flower (цветок). Русское «подсолнух» — от «под солнцем».
problems.answer: sun + flower — «солнечный цветок»; по-русски — «под солнцем».

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 10, с. 38. Прослушай и прочитай названия континентов, подбери транскрипцию.
steps: /ˈjʊərəp/ — Europe; /ˈeɪʒə/ — Asia; /ɒˈstreɪlɪə/ — Australia; /əˈmerɪkə/ — America; /ˈæfrɪkə/ — Africa.
problems.answer: Europe, Asia, Australia, America, Africa

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 11, с. 38. 1) Прослушай и прочитай пары слов. 2) К какой части речи относятся слова с суффиксом -an?
steps: 1) Australia — Australian; America — American; Russia — Russian; Europe — European; Asia — Asian; Africa — African; Indonesia — Indonesian.
2) Слова с суффиксом -an — прилагательные (отвечают на вопрос «какой?»).
problems.answer: Australian, American, Russian, European, Asian, African, Indonesian — прилагательные.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 12, с. 38. Прочитай письмо и найди животных на картинках.
steps: 1 — картинка 2; 2 — картинка 1.
problems.answer: картинка 2, картинка 1

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 13, с. 39. Прочитай письмо и допиши буквы в словах.
steps: Dear Sam, thank you very much for the postcard "Rain forests". It is very interesting. In Russia there are many different seas and big rivers. There are big forests and high mountains too.
problems.answer: thank you very much, Rain forests, interesting, Russia, different, rivers, forests, mountains

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 14, с. 39. Заполни пропуски в тексте подходящими глаголами (was / were / is / are).
steps: In August my rose was 30 centimetres tall. The flower was small. There were 5 leaves. Today is 7 November. Now the rose is 50 centimetres tall. There are 12 leaves on it.
problems.answer: was, was, were, is, is, are

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 15, с. 39. 1) Найди слова (цвета) в цепочке. 2) Составь диалог о любимых цветах.
steps: 1) green, brown, red, pink, orange, yellow, purple, blue, grey.
2) A: What's your favourite colour? — B: Yellow. A: Do you like green sweaters? — B: No, I don't.
problems.answer: 1) green, brown, red, pink, orange, yellow, purple, blue, grey. 2) What's your favourite colour? — …

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 16, с. 40. Сыграй в игру: опиши растение, друг угадывает.
steps: Sunflower: it is big and yellow, there are a lot of them in the south of Russia. Pitcher plant: it eats insects. Water lily: it is beautiful, it lives on the water.
problems.answer: Описываем растение (sunflower, pitcher plant, water lily) — друг угадывает.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 17, с. 40. Прочитай историю на с. 24–25 снова и определи, верны ли предложения 1–7.
steps: True, True, True, False, True, False, False.
problems.answer: T, T, T, F, T, F, F

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 18, с. 40. В парах обсудите, где вы были в августе.
steps: A: Where were you in August? — B: I was in Turkey. And you? — A: I was in the country.
problems.answer: Where were you in August? — I was in …

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 19, с. 41. Прочитай слова, скажи, что у них общего, и запиши транскрипцию выделенных букв.
steps: Во всех словах есть удвоенные согласные, которые читаются как один звук: ll — /l/, dd — /d/, ff — /f/, pp — /p/, ss — /s/ (в слове Russia — /ʃ/).
problems.answer: Двойные согласные читаются как один звук: /l/, /d/, /f/, /p/, /s/, в Russia — /ʃ/.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 20, с. 41. Посмотри на картинку и обсуди рост изображённых людей, животных и предметов.
steps: A: How tall are the explorers? — B: They are two metres tall. A: How tall is the elephant? — B: Four metres. A: How tall is the ladder? — B: Six metres. A: How tall is the tent? — B: Three metres.
problems.answer: How tall is / are …? — … metres tall

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 21, с. 41. Прослушай предложения и скажи, на какие слова падает ударение и какие это части речи.
steps: Ударение падает на подчёркнутые смысловые слова — существительные, прилагательные, глаголы, наречия. Служебные слова (артикли, предлоги) безударны.
problems.answer: Ударные — существительные, прилагательные, глаголы, наречия; безударные — артикли и предлоги.

problems.condition: Unit 5, упр. 22, с. 41. Измерь свой рост и рост друзей, запиши ответы.
steps: I'm 150 centimetres tall. Masha is 120 centimetres tall. Sasha is 128 centimetres tall.
problems.answer: I'm … centimetres tall. … is … centimetres tall.

chapters.title: 6. What do you know about Russia?

problems.condition: Unit 6 What do you know about Russia?, упр. 1, с. 42. Прочитай текст и ответь на вопросы.
steps: Russia is bigger than Australia and the USA. It is the biggest country in the world. I live in Russia.
problems.answer: Russia is bigger than Australia and the USA. I live in Russia.

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 2, с. 43. Прочитай текст о разных регионах России и скажи, куда бы ты хотел поехать.
steps: I want to go to Kamchatka to see the volcanoes. / I want to go to Lake Baikal.
problems.answer: I want to go to Kamchatka / Baikal / St Petersburg.

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 3, с. 44. Прочитай и скажи, какие утверждения верны.
steps: False, True, False, False, True.
problems.answer: F, T, F, F, T

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 4, с. 44. Поговори о своём родном крае, используя слова из рамки.
steps: A: Where do you live? — B: I live in Moscow. A: Is there an airport in Moscow? — B: Yes, there are three airports. A: Are there many museums and theatres? — B: Yes, there are a lot. A: Is there a river? — B: Yes, the Moskva River.
problems.answer: Where do you live? Is there an airport / a river? Are there many museums? — ответы о своём городе.

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 5, с. 44. Найди в цепочке названия месяцев.
steps: June, July, August; September, October, November; March, April, May; December, January, February.
problems.answer: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 6, с. 44. Сделай свой календарь: впиши месяцы по временам года и подбери картинки.
steps: Winter — December, January, February. Spring — March, April, May. Summer — June, July, August. Autumn — September, October, November.
problems.answer: winter: December, January, February; spring: March, April, May; summer: June, July, August; autumn: September, October, November

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 7, с. 44. Поговори с другом о временах года и ответь на вопросы.
steps: There are four seasons in a year. My favourite season is summer. There are twelve months in a year. My favourite month is June.
problems.answer: four seasons; favourite — summer; twelve months; favourite month — June

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 8, с. 45. Послушай и покажи животных на картинках.
steps: a fox — лиса; a bear — медведь; a tiger — тигр; a wolf — волк; a robin — малиновка; a rabbit — кролик; a squirrel — белка; a blackbird — дрозд.
problems.answer: fox, bear, tiger, wolf, robin, rabbit, squirrel, blackbird

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 9, с. 45. Прочитай текст и поговори с другом о животных России.
steps: A: What's this? — B: It's a wolf / a fox / a rabbit. A: Where does it live? — B: It lives in big forests. A: Who lives in Kamchatka and Siberia? — B: Brown bears. A: Where can we see blackbirds and robins? — B: By rivers and in parks.
problems.answer: What's this? Where does it live? Who lives in Siberia? Where can we see …? — по тексту

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 10, с. 45. Сыграй в игру I spy, используя все названия животных из упр. 8.
steps: A: I spy with my little eye something beginning with B. — B: It's a bear! A: …beginning with W. — B: A wolf. A: …beginning with R. — B: A robin / a rabbit. A: …beginning with S. — B: A squirrel.
problems.answer: I spy with my little eye something beginning with … — bear, wolf, robin, rabbit, squirrel, fox, tiger, blackbird

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 11, с. 46. Выпиши из текста упр. 8 названия животных во множественном числе, рядом напиши единственное число и определи звук окончания.

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 12, с. 46. Прочитай карточки животных и опиши их.
steps: This platypus is two years old. It's from Australia. It lives in lakes and rivers. It has got short legs and a flat tail. It can swim and dive.
This tiger is four years old. It's from Siberia, Russia. It lives in the taiga. It has got strong legs and a long tail. It can run, climb and swim.
problems.answer: Описание по карточке: age, from, lives in, has got, can.

problems.condition: Unit 6, упр. 13, с. 46. Напиши, какое животное больше.
steps: An elephant is bigger than a bear. A rat is bigger than a frog. A wolf is bigger than a fox.
problems.answer: An elephant is bigger than a bear. A rat is bigger than a frog. A wolf is bigger than a fox.
